description: Main JavaScript source file for the Quick Notes Organizer web application. It initializes the app UI, manages notes stored in localStorage, and handles user interactions such as creating, editing, deleting, and searching notes.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from localStorage, parsing JSON data or returning an empty array if parsing fails.

methods.name: saveNotes
methods.description: Saves the current notes array to localStorage as a JSON string.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new empty note with a unique ID and adds it to the notes list.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID and updates the selection accordingly.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates a note's fields and moves it to the top of the list, updating its 'updatedAt' timestamp.

methods.name: currentNote
methods.description: Returns the currently selected note object.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets the currently selected note by ID and updates the editor view.

methods.name: filteredNotes
methods.description: Returns notes filtered by the current search query.

methods.name: highlightSelection
methods.description: Highlights the selected note in the list UI.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a locale-specific date string.

methods.name: emptyStateMarkup
methods.description: Returns HTML markup for the empty state when no notes are present.

methods.name: noteItemMarkup
methods.description: Generates HTML markup for a single note item in the list.

methods.name: escapeHtml
methods.description: Escapes special HTML characters in a string to prevent injection.

methods.name: renderListOnly
methods.description: Renders the list of notes based on current filter and selection.

methods.name: attachListHandlers
methods.description: Attaches click and keyboard event handlers to note list items.

methods.name: renderEditor
methods.description: Updates the note editing area with the current note's data.

methods.name: updateEditorMeta
methods.description: Updates the metadata display (last updated time) for the current note.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders both the note list and the editor view.

methods.name: focusTitle
methods.description: Sets focus to the note title input field.
